explanation: Relation: A is something contrived for the express purpose of B-ing. A decoy is set out precisely to beguile its quarry; an alibi is offered precisely to exonerate the accused.

distractor_rationales.avalanche is to engulf: An avalanche engulfs by blind natural force; nobody contrives it for that purpose.
distractor_rationales.escapee is to recapture: An escapee is the one who gets recaptured (the object of the action), not a device made to recapture.
distractor_rationales.procrastinator is to stall: Stalling is what a procrastinator habitually does (a trait), not a purpose the person was devised for.
distractor_rationales.contraband is to confiscate: Contraband is what customs officers confiscate (object of B); it is not made for the purpose of being confiscated.

explanation: Relation: A is a device whose purpose is to B. A mnemonic exists to help one recall; an epitaph exists to memorialize the dead.

distractor_rationales.illiterate is to decipher: An illiterate person is unable to decipher writing: absence of B, not purpose.
distractor_rationales.worrier is to agonize: Agonizing is a worrier's habitual tendency, not a designed purpose.
distractor_rationales.geyser is to spew: A geyser spews water by natural behaviour; it was not made in order to spew.
distractor_rationales.legacy is to bequeath: A legacy is what one bequeaths (object of B), not a device whose purpose is to bequeath.

explanation: Relation: A is created in order to B (its defining purpose). A subpoena is issued to compel a witness; a satire is written to deride folly.

distractor_rationales.dilettante is to dabble: Dabbling is what a dilettante characteristically does; a person is not an instrument with a purpose.
distractor_rationales.comet is to orbit: A comet orbits by natural motion, not by design or intent.
distractor_rationales.detainee is to parole: A detainee is the one who may be paroled (object of B).
distractor_rationales.loophole is to exploit: A loophole is what people exploit (object of B); no one creates a loophole for that purpose.

explanation: Relation: A is a deliberate manoeuvre whose purpose is to B an opponent. A blockade is mounted to isolate an enemy; a bluff is made to hoodwink an opponent.

distractor_rationales.gourmand is to relish: Relishing food is a gourmand's habitual behaviour, not a purpose A was devised for.
distractor_rationales.insurgent is to subdue: An insurgent is the one others try to subdue (object of B).
distractor_rationales.meteor is to streak: A meteor streaks by natural motion; no purpose is involved.
distractor_rationales.controversy is to flare: A controversy characteristically flares up; that is how it behaves, not a goal anyone designed it for.

explanation: Relation: A is adopted for the purpose of securing B. A pseudonym is adopted to secure anonymity; a chaperone is present to secure respectability.

distractor_rationales.indolence is to penury: Indolence tends to produce penury (cause and effect); nobody adopts it in order to be poor.
distractor_rationales.stutter is to jitteriness: A stutter can be an outward sign of jitteriness (sign of an inner state), not a means of securing it.
distractor_rationales.forgery is to signature: A forgery is a fraudulent imitation of a signature; it is not used to secure one.
distractor_rationales.liniment is to stiffness: A liniment is applied to relieve stiffness: it removes B rather than securing it.

explanation: Relation: A is conducted for the purpose of B. A census is conducted for the enumeration of a population; an audit is conducted for the verification of accounts.

distractor_rationales.deprivation is to craving: Deprivation produces craving as an unintended effect; nobody conducts it for that purpose.
distractor_rationales.pacing is to fretting: Pacing is the outward sign of fretting, not a procedure undertaken to achieve it.
distractor_rationales.salve is to abrasion: A salve is applied to an abrasion to soothe it; it relieves B rather than aiming at it.
distractor_rationales.heresy is to orthodoxy: Heresy is a departure from orthodoxy, the opposite of serving it.

explanation: Relation: A is a formal instrument whose purpose is to B. A manifesto is issued to proclaim principles; a tribunal is convened to adjudicate disputes.

distractor_rationales.fad is to fizzle: A fad characteristically fizzles out; that is its typical fate, not its purpose.
distractor_rationales.borrower is to owe: A borrower is by definition one who owes: B is A's condition, not A's purpose.
distractor_rationales.hostage is to ransom: A hostage is the one who is ransomed (object of B).
distractor_rationales.tide is to surge: A tide surges by natural force; there is no purpose.

explanation: Relation: A is put in place in order to B something vulnerable. A buttress is built to reinforce a wall; a tariff is imposed to cushion domestic producers from foreign competition.

distractor_rationales.inflation is to spiral: Inflation tends to spiral; that is its characteristic behaviour, not a purpose it was put in place to serve.
distractor_rationales.defendant is to acquit: A defendant is the one who may be acquitted (object of B).
distractor_rationales.convalescent is to recuperate: A convalescent is one who is recuperating: B is A's state, not a purpose.
distractor_rationales.dew is to evaporate: Dew evaporates naturally; no one places it to do so.

explanation: Relation: A, left unchecked, characteristically brings about B. Complacency tends to bring about stagnation; mismanagement tends to bring about a deficit.

distractor_rationales.groveling is to servility: Groveling is the outward show of servility (sign); servility comes first and is displayed, not produced.
distractor_rationales.emollient is to chafing: An emollient relieves chafing (counteracts B) rather than producing it.
distractor_rationales.qualifying is to tournament: Qualifying is the preparatory round before a tournament; it does not cause the tournament.
distractor_rationales.abstention is to ballot: An abstention is declining to cast a ballot; it withholds B rather than producing it.

explanation: Relation: A provokes B as a reaction in those subjected to it. Tyranny provokes insurrection among the oppressed; condescension provokes umbrage in those it is aimed at.

distractor_rationales.squirm is to discomfort: A squirm is the outward sign of discomfort; the discomfort is shown, not provoked.
distractor_rationales.refutation is to fallacy: A refutation counteracts a fallacy; it does not provoke one.
distractor_rationales.orientation is to semester: Orientation is the preparatory step before a semester, not its cause.
distractor_rationales.plagiarism is to attribution: Plagiarism is the breach of proper attribution; it violates B rather than provoking it.

explanation: Relation: A, a failing, leads in time to B. Conceit leads in time to a comeuppance; procrastination leads to a backlog.

distractor_rationales.snarl is to ire: A snarl is the outward sign of ire; ire is expressed by it, not produced by it.
distractor_rationales.balm is to chapping: A balm relieves chapping; it counteracts B.
distractor_rationales.enrollment is to coursework: Enrollment is the preparatory step before coursework, not a failing that produces it.
distractor_rationales.renunciation is to throne: Renunciation gives up a throne lawfully; A relinquishes B, it does not produce it.

explanation: Relation: A, by its nature, breeds B. Secrecy breeds mistrust; impunity breeds lawlessness.

distractor_rationales.goosebumps is to eeriness: Goosebumps are an involuntary outward sign of eeriness felt (sign), not its cause.
distractor_rationales.tonic is to lassitude: A tonic relieves lassitude; it counteracts B rather than breeding it.
distractor_rationales.countdown is to liftoff: A countdown is the preparatory sequence before liftoff; it precedes B by plan, it does not breed it.
distractor_rationales.torpor is to sluggishness: Torpor and sluggishness are near-synonyms; one does not breed the other.

explanation: Relation: A characteristically produces B as its result. Infighting produces deadlock; ambiguity produces misunderstanding.

distractor_rationales.blink is to flash: A blink is a reflex reaction to a flash: B prompts A, the reverse of A producing B.
distractor_rationales.antihistamine is to allergen: An antihistamine counteracts the effect of an allergen rather than producing it.
distractor_rationales.taxiing is to takeoff: Taxiing is the preparatory step before takeoff; it precedes B by procedure, it does not produce it.
distractor_rationales.smuggling is to customs: Smuggling evades customs; it is a breach of B, not a cause of it.

explanation: Relation: A, imposed on a group, stirs up B within it. Austerity stirs up restiveness among the public; favoritism stirs up acrimony among those passed over.

distractor_rationales.beaming is to gratification: Beaming is the outward sign of gratification (sign), not something that stirs it up.
distractor_rationales.perfume is to mustiness: Perfume masks mustiness; it covers B rather than producing it.
distractor_rationales.concord is to unanimity: Concord and unanimity are near-synonyms; neither produces the other.
distractor_rationales.tryout is to season: A tryout is the preparatory step before a season, not its cause.

explanation: Relation: A, a habit, leads to B, a bad end. Prodigality leads to destitution; idleness (proverbially) leads to delinquency.

distractor_rationales.chortle is to merriment: A chortle is the outward expression of merriment; merriment comes first and shows in it.
distractor_rationales.euphemism is to tactlessness: A euphemism avoids tactlessness; it counteracts B rather than leading to it.
distractor_rationales.cocoon is to metamorphosis: A cocoon is the place where metamorphosis happens: location, not a habit leading to a bad end.
distractor_rationales.repeal is to ordinance: A repeal lawfully annuls an ordinance; it ends B rather than producing it.

explanation: Relation: A brings B upon the person who experiences A. Drudgery brings weariness on the worker; notoriety brings scrutiny on the notorious.

distractor_rationales.huffing is to pique: Huffing is the outward display of pique, not something that brings pique on a person.
distractor_rationales.ventilation is to stuffiness: Ventilation relieves stuffiness; it removes B.
distractor_rationales.candidacy is to inauguration: Candidacy is the stage before inauguration; it precedes B, it does not bring B on anyone.
distractor_rationales.truancy is to attendance: Truancy is a breach of required attendance; it violates B.

explanation: Relation: A is the involuntary facial reaction that shows B. A wince shows hurt; a gape shows astonishment.

distractor_rationales.mockery is to humiliation: Mockery produces humiliation in its target (cause and effect); it does not show the mocker's own state.
distractor_rationales.yelp is to pinch: A yelp is an involuntary cry at a pinch, but B is the external blow that triggers it, not an inner feeling it shows.
distractor_rationales.rejoinder is to jibe: A rejoinder is a reply made to a jibe; A responds to B, it does not express an inner state.
distractor_rationales.bigamy is to monogamy: Bigamy breaches monogamy; violation, not expression.

explanation: Relation: A is the outward bodily sign of B, an inner state of restlessness or tedium. A yawn betrays ennui; drumming the fingers betrays impatience.

distractor_rationales.tedium is to lethargy: Tedium produces lethargy (cause and effect): both are inner conditions and neither is a visible sign.
distractor_rationales.detergent is to grime: A detergent removes grime (counteract), it does not display it.
distractor_rationales.audition is to debut: An audition precedes a debut as a step toward it (preparation), not as its outward sign.
distractor_rationales.handshake is to acquaintance: A handshake is offered TO an acquaintance: B is the recipient of the gesture, not the inner state it expresses.

explanation: Relation: A is the wordless vocal sound by which a person expresses B. A hoot expresses derision; a moan expresses suffering.

distractor_rationales.betrayal is to bitterness: Betrayal produces bitterness in the betrayed (cause and effect), it is not an outward sign.
distractor_rationales.humming is to desperation: Humming is a wordless vocal sound, but it suggests ease or contentment, not desperation: the sound does not match the feeling.
distractor_rationales.deliberation is to judgment: Deliberation is the preparatory step before a judgment.
distractor_rationales.transcript is to oration: A transcript is a written copy of an oration: A records B, it does not express an inner state.

explanation: Relation: A is a bearing or expression that displays B, a self-regarding attitude. A pout displays petulance; a strut displays self-importance.

distractor_rationales.indulgence is to selfishness: Indulgence breeds selfishness (cause and effect); it is not a visible display.
distractor_rationales.mimicry is to mannerism: Mimicry imitates a mannerism: A copies an outward B, it does not display an inner attitude.
distractor_rationales.browning is to braising: Browning the meat is the preparatory step before braising.
distractor_rationales.shuffle is to exuberance: A shuffle is a bearing, but it displays weariness or reluctance, never exuberance: the bearing does not match the attitude.

explanation: Relation: A is the conventional bodily sign of B, an attitude toward someone or something. A frown conventionally signals dissatisfaction; prostration conventionally signals submission.

distractor_rationales.condolence is to bereavement: Condolence is offered in response to a bereavement: B is the occasion of A, not the inner attitude A displays.
distractor_rationales.titter is to solemnity: A titter is a bodily sign, but of nervous amusement; it does not signal solemnity.
distractor_rationales.calibration is to measurement: Calibration is the preparatory step before measurement.
distractor_rationales.sacrilege is to piety: Sacrilege offends against piety; it violates B rather than expressing it.

explanation: Relation: A is the visible expression of B in face or posture. A swagger is cockiness made visible; a slump is dejection made visible.

distractor_rationales.isolation is to loneliness: Isolation produces loneliness (cause and effect); neither is visible.
distractor_rationales.prance is to desolation: A prance is a visible expression, but of high spirits; it never displays desolation.
distractor_rationales.whetting is to carving: Whetting the blade is the preparatory step before carving.
distractor_rationales.inkling is to premonition: An inkling and a premonition are both inner intuitions (near-synonyms); neither is an outward sign.

explanation: Relation: A is the collective audible expression of B by a crowd. An ovation is a crowd voicing approbation; booing is a crowd voicing disfavor.

distractor_rationales.virtuosity is to admiration: Virtuosity wins admiration (cause and effect); it is the cause of the feeling, not its expression.
distractor_rationales.hush is to jubilation: A hush falls over a crowd from suspense or awe-struck attention; it does not voice jubilation, so the sign does not match the feeling.
distractor_rationales.scouting is to expedition: Scouting is the preparatory step before an expedition.
distractor_rationales.encore is to finale: An encore is an extra piece played after the finale: what follows B, not a crowd's expression of a feeling.

explanation: Relation: A is the involuntary outward sign of B, an intense inner feeling. A recoil betrays repugnance; blanching betrays shock.

distractor_rationales.suspense is to jitters: Suspense produces jitters (cause and effect); A is a situation, not an outward sign.
distractor_rationales.sanitation is to filth: Sanitation removes filth (counteract); it does not betray a feeling.
distractor_rationales.excavation is to foundation: Excavation is the preparatory step before the foundation is laid.
distractor_rationales.simper is to antipathy: A simper is a silly, affected smile; it does not betray antipathy.

explanation: Relation: A relieves or neutralizes B, an ill that is already present. An antivenom is given to neutralize a toxin already in the body; consolation is offered to relieve misery already felt.

distractor_rationales.slander is to infamy: Slander produces infamy for its victim (cause and effect); it creates B rather than relieving it.
distractor_rationales.tantrum is to vexation: A tantrum is the outward display of vexation (sign).
distractor_rationales.vigilance is to ambush: Vigilance forestalls an ambush before it happens (prevention); it does not relieve an ill already present.
distractor_rationales.cramming is to examination: Cramming is the preparatory step before an examination.

explanation: Relation: A relieves B, a strained state, by easing it. A sedative eases agitation; humor eases tension.

distractor_rationales.turbulence is to queasiness: Turbulence produces queasiness (cause and effect), the opposite of easing it.
distractor_rationales.quaking is to dismay: Quaking is an outward sign of dismay (sign).
distractor_rationales.makeup is to blemish: Makeup conceals a blemish: it hides B from view without relieving or removing it.

explanation: Relation: A is applied after B has occurred, to undo the harm of B. A lozenge is taken to undo hoarseness; a retraction is published to undo the harm of a libel.

distractor_rationales.corruption is to cynicism: Corruption breeds cynicism (cause and effect); it creates B rather than undoing it.
distractor_rationales.scowl is to displeasure: A scowl is the outward sign of displeasure (sign).
distractor_rationales.thawing is to roasting: Thawing is the preparatory step before roasting.
distractor_rationales.trespass is to boundary: A trespass is a violation of a boundary (violation), not a remedy for it.

explanation: Relation: A is given to relieve B, a suffering already being endured. An analgesic relieves a migraine; alms relieve privation.

distractor_rationales.cheering is to elation: Cheering is the outward expression of elation (sign).
distractor_rationales.antifreeze is to icing: Antifreeze keeps icing from occurring at all (prevention); it does not relieve an existing ill.
distractor_rationales.vetting is to appointment: Vetting is the preparatory step before an appointment.

explanation: Relation: A soothes and reduces B, a present distress. Reassurance soothes apprehension; a poultice soothes inflammation.

distractor_rationales.oppression is to exodus: Oppression drives an exodus (cause and effect).
distractor_rationales.laughter is to amusement: Laughter is the outward expression of amusement (sign).
distractor_rationales.mobilization is to campaign: Mobilization is the preparatory step before a campaign.

explanation: Relation: A clears away B, a condition already present. Absolution clears away guilt; fumigation clears away an infestation.

distractor_rationales.frugality is to prosperity: Frugality produces prosperity (cause and effect); it brings B about rather than clearing it away.
distractor_rationales.grinning is to jubilance: Grinning is the outward sign of jubilance (sign).
distractor_rationales.galvanizing is to corrosion: Galvanizing keeps corrosion from starting (prevention); it acts before B exists, not on B once present.
distractor_rationales.apostasy is to denomination: Apostasy is the abandonment of one's denomination or faith (violation).

explanation: Relation: A is offered to remedy B, a harm already done. An antacid remedies heartburn; amends remedy an affront.

distractor_rationales.research is to thesis: Research is the preparatory step before a thesis.
distractor_rationales.aftermath is to upheaval: An aftermath is the period that follows an upheaval: A comes after B but does nothing to remedy it.
distractor_rationales.misstep is to slip: A misstep and a slip are near-synonyms; neither remedies the other.

explanation: Relation: A sets right B, a breakdown or wrong that has already occurred. Mediation breaks an impasse that has already set in; restitution sets right a larceny already committed.

distractor_rationales.ordeal is to toughness: An ordeal builds toughness (cause and effect); A produces B rather than setting it right.
distractor_rationales.deterrent is to invasion: A deterrent forestalls an invasion before it occurs (prevention), rather than setting right a wrong already done.
distractor_rationales.groundwork is to construction: Groundwork is the preparatory step before construction.
distractor_rationales.hugging is to tenderness: Hugging is an outward expression of tenderness (sign).

explanation: Relation: A is the preparatory step undertaken before B so that B can succeed. Reconnaissance is carried out before an offensive; tuning is done before a recital.

distractor_rationales.overconfidence is to oversight: Overconfidence leads to oversight (cause and effect), not a deliberate preparatory step.
distractor_rationales.minutes is to session: Minutes are the record made of a session, during and after it, not a step taken to prepare for it.
distractor_rationales.smiling is to cordiality: Smiling is the outward sign of cordiality (sign).

explanation: Relation: A is the step done first so that B can proceed properly. Preheating comes before baking; brainstorming comes before composing.

distractor_rationales.adjournment is to proceedings: An adjournment ends the proceedings; it comes at the close of B, not before it.
distractor_rationales.bristling is to rancor: Bristling is the outward sign of rancor (sign).

explanation: Relation: A is the preliminary process that must be completed before B. Triage precedes surgery; negotiation precedes ratification.

distractor_rationales.jealousy is to estrangement: Jealousy leads to estrangement (cause and effect), not as a planned preliminary.
distractor_rationales.postscript is to memo: A postscript is added after a memo is written; it follows B rather than preparing for it.
distractor_rationales.whooping is to exhilaration: Whooping is the outward expression of exhilaration (sign).

explanation: Relation: A is the step one must take beforehand in order to do B. Stretching comes before calisthenics; registration comes before voting.

distractor_rationales.clapping is to appreciation: Clapping is the outward expression of appreciation (sign).
distractor_rationales.defrosting is to frost: Defrosting removes frost (counteract); B is what A clears away, not what A prepares for.
distractor_rationales.expiry is to warranty: Expiry is the lawful end of a warranty; it marks B's end, not a step toward it.

explanation: Relation: A is the preparatory stage that comes before B and makes it possible. Fueling precedes a launch; courtship precedes matrimony.

distractor_rationales.affluence is to decadence: Affluence can breed decadence (cause and effect).
distractor_rationales.snorting is to disdain: Snorting is the outward expression of disdain (sign).
distractor_rationales.eulogy is to funeral: A eulogy is delivered during a funeral: A is part of B, not a stage before it.

explanation: Relation: A is the step taken immediately before B, without which B cannot begin. Screening comes before admission; saddling comes before riding.

distractor_rationales.lolling is to languor: Lolling is the outward sign of languor (sign).
distractor_rationales.intermission is to play: An intermission is a pause in the middle of a play, not a step before it.
distractor_rationales.bailout is to collapse: A bailout counteracts a collapse; it relieves B rather than preparing for it.

explanation: Relation: A is the earlier process that must be carried out before B can be done. Troops are mustered before a march; a wash is fermented before distillation.

distractor_rationales.skulking is to cowardice: Skulking is the outward sign of cowardice (sign).
distractor_rationales.residue is to combustion: Residue is what is left after combustion; it follows B rather than preparing for it.

explanation: Relation: A is the step done first so that B can be carried out. Anesthesia is given before an operation; skates are laced before skating.

distractor_rationales.souvenir is to tour: A souvenir is a memento kept after a tour, not a step before it.
distractor_rationales.probation is to offender: Probation is a condition imposed on an offender: B is the person subject to A.
distractor_rationales.recovery is to downturn: A recovery reverses a downturn (counteract), coming after B rather than before it.

explanation: Relation: A is the act by which a person breaks B, a solemn promise that person has made. Infidelity breaks the vows of wedlock; desertion breaks the sworn commitment of enlistment.

distractor_rationales.compliance is to regulation: Compliance keeps a regulation: the opposite of breaking B.
distractor_rationales.forfeiture is to deposit: Forfeiture of a deposit is the PENALTY that may follow a breach, not the breach itself.
distractor_rationales.cancellation is to subscription: A cancellation ends a subscription lawfully, by its own terms; nothing is betrayed.
distractor_rationales.wheezing is to asthma: Wheezing is an outward sign of asthma (sign).

explanation: Relation: A is the failure to honor the terms of B, an agreement one entered into. Default breaks the terms of a mortgage; absconding breaks the terms of bail.

distractor_rationales.fulfillment is to covenant: Fulfillment honors a covenant: the opposite of breaching it.
distractor_rationales.eviction is to lodger: Eviction is a penalty applied to a lodger: B is the person acted on, not an agreement broken.
distractor_rationales.veto is to bill: A veto lawfully rejects a bill; it is an exercise of a power, not a breach.
distractor_rationales.insurance is to burglary: Insurance compensates for a burglary after it occurs (counteract), it does not break anything.

explanation: Relation: A is the misconduct by which an official betrays B, a duty of the office. Nepotism betrays an official's duty of impartiality; embezzlement betrays an official's duty of honest stewardship.

distractor_rationales.impeachment is to magistrate: Impeachment is a process brought against a magistrate: B is the person accused, not a duty betrayed.
distractor_rationales.integrity is to honesty: Integrity and honesty are near-synonymous virtues; neither breaches the other.
distractor_rationales.expulsion is to member: Expulsion is a penalty imposed on a member: B is the person punished.
distractor_rationales.hindsight is to mistake: Hindsight is the clear view of a mistake after it is made; it looks back on B rather than betraying it.

explanation: Relation: A is the act by which one abandons the people to whom B binds one. Strikebreaking abandons fellow strikers and so breaks solidarity; jilting abandons a fiance and so breaks a betrothal.

distractor_rationales.boycott is to retailer: A boycott is collective pressure aimed AT a retailer: B is the target, not a commitment broken.
distractor_rationales.retirement is to career: Retirement ends a career honourably; nothing is betrayed.
distractor_rationales.renewal is to passport: A renewal extends a passport: it keeps B going rather than breaking it.
distractor_rationales.induction is to trainee: An induction is a ceremony that admits a trainee: B is the person admitted.

explanation: Relation: A is the lapse by which one breaks B, a regimen of self-restraint one has undertaken. A relapse breaks a pledge of abstinence; a splurge breaks a budget.

distractor_rationales.temperance is to excess: Temperance is the avoidance of excess (opposites), not a breach of a regimen.
distractor_rationales.gorging is to buffet: Gorging is what one may do at a buffet: B is the occasion, not a commitment broken.
distractor_rationales.satiety is to surfeit: Satiety is being full and surfeit is being overfull: a mild to extreme scale, not a breach.
distractor_rationales.thunderstorm is to runoff: A thunderstorm produces runoff (cause and effect).

explanation: Relation: A is the failure by which someone entrusted with a role betrays B, what that role requires. Partisanship by a referee betrays the neutrality the role requires; dereliction betrays the duty a post requires.

distractor_rationales.moderator is to debate: A moderator is the one who runs a debate: role and event, not breach and duty.
distractor_rationales.objectivity is to detachment: Objectivity and detachment are near-synonyms; neither breaches the other.
distractor_rationales.overtime is to shift: Overtime is work beyond a shift: A exceeds B rather than betraying it.
distractor_rationales.sabbatical is to scholar: A sabbatical is a sanctioned leave granted to a scholar: B is the person, and the leave is permitted, not a breach.

explanation: Relation: A is the conduct that breaches B, a code a participant is bound to observe. Doping breaches the code of sportsmanship; insubordination breaches the obedience a subordinate owes.

distractor_rationales.disqualification is to contestant: Disqualification is the penalty imposed on a contestant: B is the person punished, not the code breached.
distractor_rationales.rote is to memorization: Rote drilling produces memorization (cause and effect).
distractor_rationales.observance is to sabbath: Observance keeps the sabbath: the opposite of breaching B.
distractor_rationales.scrimmage is to match: A scrimmage is a practice game before a match (preparation).

explanation: Relation: A is the act that violates B, a right that belongs to someone else. Infringement violates an inventor's patent; snooping violates a person's privacy.

distractor_rationales.royalty is to copyright: A royalty is the lawful payment for using a copyright: honoring B, not violating it.
distractor_rationales.warrant is to arrest: A warrant authorizes an arrest: A permits B rather than violating anything.
distractor_rationales.dossier is to suspect: A dossier is the file kept on a suspect: record and its subject.

explanation: Relation: A forestalls B so that B never occurs, rather than dealing with B once it has come. Inoculation forestalls an outbreak; foresight forestalls a calamity.

distractor_rationales.rebuilding is to ruin: Rebuilding repairs ruin AFTER it has occurred (counteract), the reverse of forestalling it.
distractor_rationales.resuscitation is to drowning: Resuscitation responds to a drowning already underway (counteract); it does not keep B from happening.
distractor_rationales.sedition is to turmoil: Sedition stirs up turmoil (cause and effect).
distractor_rationales.omen is to disaster: An omen foretells a disaster: it comes before B but does nothing to prevent it.

explanation: Relation: A is a precaution that keeps B from breaking out in the first place. Diplomacy keeps warfare from breaking out; sandbagging keeps an overflow from reaching what it protects.

distractor_rationales.ceasefire is to bombardment: A ceasefire halts a bombardment that is already underway (counteract), not before it breaks out.
distractor_rationales.aftershock is to quake: An aftershock follows a quake: a later echo of B, not a precaution against it.
distractor_rationales.escalation is to conflict: Escalation intensifies a conflict: it worsens B rather than keeping it from breaking out.
distractor_rationales.mopping is to seepage: Mopping cleans up seepage after it has come in (counteract).
